title: Omen
tagline: Autonomous crypto intelligence swarm that researches, verifies, and publishes market signals
description: Omen is an autonomous market-intelligence swarm for crypto. Every hour, it reads live market conditions, scans assets, researches opportunities, analyzes charts, builds trade theses, challenges them with a critic agent, and publishes approved signals or long-form intelligence reports. The system is designed for traceability: every signal links back to agent outputs, market evidence, AXL communication traces, 0G storage artifacts, compute verification, and on-chain proof anchors. Users can view live signals, intel articles, analytics, proof manifests, peer topology, and copytrade execution from the dashboard.
how_its_made: Omen is built as a TypeScript monorepo with a React/Vite/Tailwind dashboard, Express backend, Supabase Postgres database, LangGraph.js agent workflow, Gensyn AXL peer-to-peer networking, 0G Storage/Compute/Chain proofs, and Solidity contracts. The swarm runs as separate role agents: market bias, scanner, research, chart vision, analyst, critic, intel, generator, writer, publisher, plus memory. These roles communicate through deployed AXL nodes instead of an in-process broker. Market data comes from Binance, CoinGecko, CoinMarketCap, Birdeye, and DeFiLlama. Outputs are published to X and Telegram, while evidence bundles, reports, checkpoints, compute adjudications, run manifests, and post proofs are stored through 0G. The project also includes an ERC-7857-compatible iNFT for encrypted swarm intelligence and Hyperliquid copytrading for approved signals.
auto_summary: A monorepo for a crypto market-intelligence swarm with agent coordination, proof storage, dashboard APIs, and supporting smart contracts.
